generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential integers starting at 1, unique per table, never NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Sample from parent PK pool; with probability 0.15 emit NULL (only if column nullable); otherwise pick a parent key, occasionally (10%) a key not present in parent to create unmatched rows.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_range: Uniform integer within the column's stated range rule; include boundary values and one step outside when a comparison_boundary target exists.
generic_sampling_rules.text_enum: Uniform choice from the enum list; include near-variants (case/whitespace/typo) with 10% probability when a LIKE/equality literal target exists.
generic_sampling_rules.text_free: Short synthetic token (e.g. 'val_<n>'); 20-50% duplicate share when a DISTINCT target exists; near-variants of listed literals with 10% probability.
generic_sampling_rules.text_nullable: With probability equal to the column's null share emit NULL; otherwise sample per text rule.
generic_sampling_rules.date_year: Integer year within stated range; include boundary years and one step outside when targeted.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share_default: For nullable columns without an explicit target, NULL share 0.10; at least one NULL row per nullable column per instance.
